    • cursorPositionInVworld

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f cursorPositionInVworld(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f cursorPos, int awtX, int awtY, org.jogamp.java3d.Canvas3D canvas3d, float distance)
      Description copied from interface: CursorModule
      Given an (x,y) position in a canvas return where the cursor would be in virtual world coordinates. This routine returns the same value as setCursorPosition, but unlike this function it does not actually move the cursor. awtX and awtY are the cursor position within the canvas distance is the desired distance from the eye to place the cursor
      Specified by:
      cursorPositionInVworld in interface CursorModule
      Parameters:
      cursorPos - the Vector3f object to put in the cursor position.
      awtX - the x cursor position within the canvas
      awtY - the y cursor position within the canvas
      distance - Desired distance from the eye to place the cursor. Set to NaN for the default distance.
      Returns:
      the cursor position in virtual world coordinates.
